description: Use this when a tld.expert tool's answer was wrong, incomplete or unusable for your task: a verdict or price you have reason to doubt, a field or filter you needed that is missing, an error you could not act on, or a question none of the tools could answer. Say what you called, what came back, what you expected and the fix you would make (a new field, a different default, a better error). A person at tld.expert reads every report and agreed fixes ship to these tools. It does not change the answer you already have, so carry on with the user's task. Never include the user's personal details or any keys; emails and key-like strings are removed before anyone sees the report. One report per problem.

expected.description: What a right or useful answer would have been, and how you know if you do.

proposed_fix.description: The change you would make: a field, a filter, a default, a clearer error, a new tool.

query.description: Optional: the domain, name or TLD involved, e.g. "acme.io" or ".ai".

tool.description: The tool that fell short, or "other" for a question no tool covers.

what_happened.description: What you called (the arguments) and what came back that was wrong, missing or unusable.

name: submit_feedback
title: Report a problem with a tld.expert answer
